notes.title: Character Introduction!Part 2.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34552697/f427ac547676abb1d7487c460b29ea2aff9867d9.jpg[/img]

Sanjay:
Sanjay used to be a military scientist working for the British Army. Obsessed with tech-related research, Sanjay is so crazy that he has transformed himself into a robot.

桑傑:
原任職於英國軍隊的軍事科學家，著迷於科技相關研究，瘋狂到將自己打造成機器改造人。

Veronica:

Veronica is a hearty SWAT agent who seems to overlook details but actually has a keen observation.

薇若妮卡:
美國的特種警察，個性爽朗，看似不太在意小細節，但觀察事物非常敏銳。

notes.title: Character Introduction!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34552697/dd9ba95c8058315c65859c50c2c74ffc7009c3b0.jpg[/img]

Lily:
As an officer in VIP Protection Unit, Lily is extra meticulous and always leaves people the impression of being stern and serious.

玲:
香港G4組織的特警，做事小心謹慎，總是給人正經嚴肅的形象。

James:
James works for the MI6 and appears as a traditional agent, elegant and confident.

詹姆士:
來自英國的秘密情報局，擁有傳統的特務形象，優雅自信。
